title: Revision Request
description: A single-file review proposal named <complete-target-filename>.rr, such as manuscript.tex.rr. Opening it does not change the target.

title.description: Nonblank request-title metadata, at most 2,000 UTF-8 bytes. Not displayed in the preview banner.

description.description: Optional request-level metadata; not displayed as a banner explanation. At most 50,000 UTF-8 bytes.

path.description: Forward-slash path relative to the VS Code workspace folder containing this .rr file. Must remain inside that folder. Use nonempty segments; . and .., Windows reserved device names, colons, backslashes, and trailing dots or spaces are rejected.

before.description: Exact original UTF-8 text, including its original line endings and final newline. At most 5 MiB of UTF-8 text; NUL is not supported.

after.description: Exact proposed replacement text. No changes are written until accepted. At most 5 MiB of UTF-8 text; NUL is not supported.

reason.description: Default explanation for each change block. A matching explanations entry overrides it; blank text disables the block Why button. At most 50,000 UTF-8 bytes.

explanations.description: Block explanations matched by the exact first original line (oldStart). Each line must be unique. Unmatched entries are unused.

line.description: One-based first original line of the block, or original insertion position for a pure insertion.

text.description: Specific block explanation, overriding reason. Empty or whitespace-only text disables Why for this block. At most 50,000 UTF-8 bytes; NUL is rejected.
